environment.description: AWS deployment with API Gateway (HTTP API type, no request validation configured) fronting a Lambda that enqueues messages directly to SQS. The SQS queue has a redrive policy (DLQ after 3 retries) but no content-based deduplication. Messages arrive in the queue exactly as submitted by the client. The consumer runs on ECS Fargate with 4 vCPUs enabling true parallel thread execution. No message ordering guarantees (standard queue, not FIFO).
